article_content: Hull City was unsuccessful in their ambitious attempt to acquire Alexandre Pato on a loan deal. The 25-year-old Brazilian forward has also been presented as an option to Everton recently. QPR's manager, Harry Redknapp, stated that his club could not manage the financial commitment required for the transfer. Everton has engaged in discussions with representatives to find a successor for Samuel Eto'o, while Hull's manager, Steve Bruce, was keen to secure a short-term loan. However, Pato's weekly earnings, which amount to approximately £60,000, present a significant obstacle. Hull City's manager, Steve Bruce, had to acknowledge that the £60,000-a-week wages were beyond the club's financial capabilities. Bruce and his team are currently in Portugal, and he is actively looking for a striker to help the team move away from the relegation zone due to numerous injuries. Between 2007 and 2012, Pato scored 63 goals in 150 games for AC Milan, playing for the Rossoneri in Serie A and the Champions League. He went back to Brazil to join Corinthians at the beginning of 2013 and is presently on loan at Sao Paulo. Everton has been in communication with intermediaries to find a replacement for Samuel Eto'o from Sampdoria.

article_content: The United Kingdom has launched its first cat DNA database to aid in solving criminal cases, following the successful use of cat hair in a manslaughter investigation. This database, which currently includes the DNA profiles of 152 domestic cats, was initiated after cat hairs were discovered on the dismembered remains of David Guy. Mr. Guy's torso was found encased in a curtain containing eight cat hairs in July 2012. Genetic analysis pointed to Tinker, the cat belonging to David Hilder, as a potential match. Hampshire police sent the hairs to California for examination, where scientists analyzed Tinker's DNA. The analysis confirmed that Tinker's DNA matched the rare genetic code found in the hairs on the body. Scientists demonstrated the rarity of the genetic type by confirming that it wasn't present in a sample of 493 cats in an American database. To reinforce their court case, the police sought to determine the rarity of this DNA in the UK. They consulted Dr. Jon Wetton, who had previously developed a similar database for UK dogs at the Forensic Science Service. Dr. Wetton explained that to assess the evidential strength of the match, a UK cat DNA database was needed, which did not exist at the time. The team secured 152 samples from a veterinary blood analysis company. Only three samples matched the crime scene hairs, validating the rarity of the DNA in the UK and strengthening the case that the hairs came from Hilder's cat. This evidence was presented at Winchester Crown Court, contributing to Hilder's manslaughter conviction. Dr. Wetton expressed hope that the database will be published for future crime investigations, highlighting its potential as a significant asset to forensic science given the UK's 10 million cats, which inadvertently leave their DNA in a quarter of households. While cat hair has been used in US and Canadian crime cases, a consolidated database did not exist. Dr. Wetton noted that his previous work involved creating a dog database for the forensic science service, which led to the proposal for a cat database. He also explained that cat hair contains both nuclear DNA, found in hair roots, and mitochondrial DNA, shared by maternally-related cats and found in even fine hair shafts. Animal DNA, specifically from pets' hairs, can link individuals to locations and items. Barbara Ottolini added that the police were fortunate in this instance because many mitochondrial types are commonly found using their testing technique. They aim to enhance DNA sequencing to better differentiate cat mitochondrial DNA and improve the evidentiary power.
translated_content: El Regne Unit ha posat en marxa la seva primera base de dades d'ADN de gats per ajudar a resoldre casos criminals, arran de l'ús exitós de pèl de gat en una investigació d'homicidi. Aquesta base de dades, que actualment inclou els perfils d'ADN de 152 gats domèstics, es va iniciar després que es descobrissin pèls de gat a les restes desmembrades de David Guy. El tors del Sr. Guy va ser trobat dins d'una cortina amb vuit pèls de gat al juliol de 2012. L'anàlisi genètica va assenyalar Tinker, el gat de David Hilder, com una possible coincidència. La policia de Hampshire va enviar els pèls a Califòrnia per ser examinats, on els científics van analitzar l'ADN de Tinker. L'anàlisi va confirmar que l'ADN de Tinker coincidia amb el rar codi genètic trobat als pèls del cos. Els científics van demostrar la raresa del tipus genètic confirmant que no era present en una mostra de 493 gats en una base de dades nord-americana. Per reforçar el cas judicial, la policia va buscar determinar si aquest ADN era igualment rar al Regne Unit. Van consultar el Dr. Jon Wetton, que havia desenvolupat una base de dades similar per a gossos del Regne Unit al Servei de Ciències Forenses. El Dr. Wetton va explicar que per avaluar la força probatòria de la coincidència, calia una base de dades d'ADN de gats del Regne Unit, que no existia en aquell moment. L'equip va obtenir 152 mostres d'una empresa que analitza mostres de sang veterinària. Només tres mostres van coincidir amb els pèls trobats a l'escena del crim, cosa que validava la raresa de l'ADN al Regne Unit i reforçava la hipòtesi que els pèls provenien del gat de Hilder. Aquesta prova es va presentar al Tribunal de la Corona de Winchester, i va contribuir a la condemna d'Hilder per homicidi. El Dr. Wetton va expressar l'esperança que la base de dades es publiqui perquè es pugui utilitzar en futures investigacions criminals, destacant el seu potencial com un actiu important per a la ciència forense, tenint en compte que hi ha 10 milions de gats al Regne Unit, que deixen el seu ADN sense voler en una quarta part de les llars. Tot i que s'ha utilitzat pèl de gat en casos criminals als Estats Units i al Canadà, no existia una base de dades consolidada. El Dr. Wetton va remarcar que el seu treball anterior va consistir a crear una base de dades de gossos per al servei de ciències forenses, fet que va portar a proposar la creació d'una base de dades de gats. També va explicar que el pèl de gat conté tant ADN nuclear (que es troba a les arrels dels pèls més grans) com ADN mitocondrial (compartit per tots els individus relacionats per línia materna), que es pot trobar fins i tot als filaments de pèl més fins. L'ADN animal, especialment el dels pèls de les mascotes, pot connectar persones a llocs i objectes. Barbara Ottolini va afegir que la policia va tenir sort en aquest cas perquè molts tipus mitocondrials són comuns quan es proven amb la tècnica que van utilitzar aquí. L'objectiu és millorar les tècniques de seqüenciació d'ADN per identificar més variacions a l'ADN mitocondrial dels gats i maximitzar el poder de discriminació de la prova.

article_content: Amid ongoing unrest that has tragically claimed hundreds of lives, Omar al-Bashir, the President of Sudan, traveled to neighboring South Sudan on Monday for discussions. He arrived by plane at the capital city of Juba and then proceeded to the presidential palace to meet with President Salva Kiir, his counterpart from South Sudan. Following their meeting, both presidents held a joint press conference. Al-Bashir, according to Sudan's official news agency, emphasized Sudan's commitment to supporting South Sudan. Al-Bashir's visit occurred as opposing factions in South Sudan's power struggle are trying to find a way to end the violence. Concurrently, negotiations between South Sudan's governing body and rebel forces began Monday in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, after delays last week. According to a statement from the Intergovernmental Authority on Development (IGAD), an East African trade organization that is helping to mediate the discussions, both delegations acknowledged the seriousness of the situation and the critical need to resolve the crisis in South Sudan. They recalled the extensive struggle for liberation that ultimately resulted in their country's independence and expressed regret over the unfortunate circumstances created by the current conflict. Negotiations are expected to resume on Tuesday. Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, the Chairperson of the African Union, stated that these negotiations 'come not a moment too soon'. She further noted that 'Not a single day can be lost in the search for peace in South Sudan' and emphasized that 'Stopping the fighting in South Sudan is not only a humanitarian imperative but also a strategic necessity, in order to halt the rapid descent of Africa's newest nation into collapse.' South Sudan was plunged into turmoil on December 15 when rebel forces loyal to Riek Machar, the former Vice President, attempted a coup. Since that time, militia members who support Machar have engaged in combat with government troops. The violence spread rapidly, with reports of widespread killings emerging throughout the nation. Even as representatives from both sides are engaged in negotiations, the fighting continues. Officials report that the three weeks of conflict have resulted in over 1,000 fatalities and the displacement of 200,000 individuals from their homes. Having seceded from Sudan in 2011 after decades of war, South Sudan is the world's newest country. Despite the separation, Al-Bashir has a vested interest in the talks. Although South Sudan and Sudan are now separate, they continue to have unresolved issues pertaining to oil. The ongoing fighting has reduced South Sudan's oil production, which is negatively affecting both economies. A related article warns: Heed the warnings: Genocide and Rwanda's lessons for South Sudan. CNN's Samira Said and Nana Karikari-apau contributed to this article.

Tot i que el Sudan del Sud i el Sudan ara estan separats, continuen tenint problemes pendents relacionats amb el petroli. article_content: Fans of Joel and Ethan Coen's movies understand their films possess a characteristically jaundiced view of the world. This underlying cynicism permeates many Coen films, such as 'Fargo,' 'Burn After Reading,' and 'A Serious Man.' This dark humor is evident in 'Inside Llewyn Davis,' a story situated within the earnest 1961 Greenwich Village folk scene. Oscar Isaac portrays Llewyn Davis as a musician grappling with hardship. He's a talented but struggling artist who depends on friends' generosity and meager earnings from gigs. He is perpetually on the brink of utter destitution. The film begins with Llewyn performing at the Gaslight Cafe, showcasing Isaac's captivating and emotive vocal performance. Isaac, born in Guatemala, embodies Llewyn with intense eyes, a bushy beard, and wild hair, resembling a hipster rabbi. He imbues the character with an imperfect, relatable quality. 'Inside Llewyn Davis' explores life's cruel ironies that befall Llewyn. Unbeknownst to most, the folk scene is nearing its end, about to be swept aside by the emergence of Dylan and the rise of commercial pop music. Llewyn maintains a complicated friendship with Jim (Justin Timberlake) and Jean (Carey Mulligan), a musical couple. Jean is expecting a child and possibly fathered by Llewyn, whom she seems to despise. When Jim and Jean perform '500 Miles,' it signals the decline of artists like Llewyn. Once half of a duo, Llewyn's partner's suicide has profoundly impacted him, causing him to act poorly. The Coens vividly portray the pre-Dylan 1960s Village, capturing the romanticism found within the discomfort of the era's settings. Despite his shortcomings, Llewyn embodies the spirit of the Village. The film follows his descent, prompting questions about the purpose of showcasing talent only to mock it. However, 'Inside Llewyn Davis' reveals the Coens' unique vision of a gifted, morose individual lost within the system. A highlight is when Llewyn records a satirical song named 'Please Mr. Kennedy,' briefly transforming the film into a vibrant folk musical. Yet, the Coens' cynicism prevents it. 'Inside Llewyn Davis' is a strangely haunting film, a loving tribute to the folk scene that ultimately rejects its protagonist. The film earns a Grade: A-.

article_content: Microsoft's Hong Kong office announced an investigation into a report concerning a potential mass suicide threat at a Chinese plant in Wuhan where Xbox systems are manufactured. The root of the issue appears to be a pay dispute among workers. A statement from Microsoft emphasized the company's commitment to worker welfare within its manufacturing supply chain and confirmed the ongoing investigation. While CNN has not independently verified the full details, both Foxconn, the plant's owner, and Microsoft have acknowledged the situation and responded to inquiries. Foxconn confirmed that approximately 150 workers protested on January 4 due to a decision to relocate employees to a different production line. The company reported that the situation was resolved peacefully, though 45 workers later chose to leave their positions. Foxconn stated that employee well-being is a priority and that they are dedicated to ensuring fair treatment and the protection of employee rights. A Microsoft spokeswoman clarified that the core of the controversy stems from grievances over staffing assignments and transfer policies, rather than general working conditions. Foxconn reportedly offered affected workers the option to transfer or resign, promising payment of outstanding salaries and bonuses based on their tenure, according to Microsoft. According to reports, most employees returned to work following the protest, with a smaller group choosing to resign. Following a series of suicides at its Shenzhen factory in 2010, Foxconn implemented pay raises for workers, according to Chinese state media reports. Microsoft maintains a stringent Vendor Code of Conduct and closely monitors working conditions to address emerging issues, reinforcing its commitment to the fair treatment and safety of workers within its vendor network. In response to the 2010 suicides, Foxconn introduced measures to improve worker welfare, including recreational activities, spiritual support from Buddhist monks, and a 24-hour help line. Foxconn is a major global electronics manufacturer that also produces goods for companies like Dell, Hewlett Packard, and Sony. In October 2010, it employed an estimated 800,000 people in China.

article_content: Astronomers suggest Jupiter and its moons represent a prime location for potentially discovering extraterrestrial life within our solar system. Consequently, the Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (Juice) mission, aimed at probing Jupiter's distant oceans, is set to launch in 2022. The five-tonne satellite is expected to arrive at Jupiter by 2030. Once there, it will employ a variety of tools to examine the planet's atmospheric conditions, magnetic field, and faint ring system. Juice will also study Jupiter's Galilean moons, notably volcanic Io, icy Europa, and the rock-ice compositions of Ganymede and Callisto. This complex forms a miniature solar system. The mission's primary focus is Ganymede, marking the first time a spacecraft has orbited an icy moon. Earlier studies indicate Ganymede might have layered ice and oceans, similar to a club sandwich. Previously, it was believed Ganymede held a thick ocean between two ice layers, but recent findings suggest multiple layers exist. Scientists emphasize the importance of water-rock interactions for life development. Earth's life may have originated in sea floor vents. Previously, Ganymede's rocky sea bottom was presumed icy, hindering life's emergence. Juice will also visit Callisto and perform flybys of Europa. The mission aims to measure Europa's ice crust thickness and identify future exploration sites. Data from the Galileo mission suggests a salty subsurface ocean connected to a rocky seafloor. The presence of salt increases ocean density, demonstrated by adding table salt to water. Instead of expanding, the liquid becomes denser as salt ions attract water molecules. Ice exists in various forms under high pressure, like in Ganymede's deep oceans. 'Ice I' is less dense and floats, while denser forms like 'Ice VI' become heavier than water and sink. Computer models suggest Ganymede has an ocean between ice layers and a rocky seafloor. Europa remains a key site for finding potential life. The cycling of material between Europa's ocean and ice shell could provide chemical energy for simple life forms. Geysers on Europa may offer a way to detect alien life beneath the surface, based on Hubble's 2013 observations of water vapor ejection. Professor Alvaro Giménez Cañete stated that Juice will provide insights into the formation of gas giants and their life-hosting potential. Juice aims to measure Europa's ice crust thickness and identify areas for future exploration.

article_content: With fur flying and paws outstretched, captivating photos reveal pet dogs seemingly posing mid-air. German photographer Julia Christe skillfully captured these mid-leap images, featuring various breeds including huskies and Chinese Crested Dogs. To create these shots, dogs were gently dropped onto a mattress by their owners from a low height, with wind machines adding dramatic flair. A puli appears to soar through the air, as captured by Julia Christe, a 41-year-old photographer from Tettnang, Germany. An adorable husky displays its best side, while a Spitz appears to fly. The project originated when Christe, seeking a fresh perspective on her favorite animal, decided to embark on this series. Although she hadn't initially planned to specialize in pet photography—despite owning two Spanish water dogs—Christe's work on commercial animal shoots ignited her passion for pet portraits. Her latest project, 'Freestyle,' showcased over 100 canines at her Berlin studio, including Boxers, Griffon Nivernais, Bearded Collies, and Australian Shepherds, among others. 'The dogs were dropped by their owners onto a mattress from a minimal height, and the illusion of flight was enhanced by wind machines,' the 41-year-old explained. An Afghan hound strikes a mid-air pose for the camera. An adorable Bearded Collie and a Dachshund appear to fly through the air. Photographer Julia Christe, 41, from Tettnang, Germany, is pictured with one of her dogs. 'Not every dog is suited to 'flying,' but some displayed remarkable talent and became true stars. Certain breeds, like greyhounds, were apprehensive about being lifted, while others, such as spaniels, thoroughly enjoyed it. 'Some dogs enjoyed it so much that we were able to repeat the jumps. The expressions on their faces often reflect surprise from the initial 'flight,' and the first jump typically yielded the best images.' However, not everyone appreciates her work. Christe has received communications from animal rights organizations expressing concerns about the dogs' well-being. 'I receive varied reactions to my pictures, ranging from fascination and astonishment to concerns voiced by animal rights activists,' she added. A Bearded Collie prepares to 'fly' behind the scenes at the photoshoot. Photographer Julia aimed to capture her favorite animal from a unique viewpoint. A massive Newfoundland dog appears to fly, its silky black fur windswept. A petite Chinese crested dog kicks up a leg for the camera. 'I genuinely love animals, and their safety was paramount; I would never risk them getting hurt. 'Considerable technical effort went into creating the photographs, including precisely adjusting the lighting and capturing the dogs' coats' rapid movement. 'I believe the photographs showcase the dogs' grace and elegance, presenting them in a subtly different and unique way.' A beagle strikes a pose, while a Griffon Nivernais looks bemused. An English setter appears rather bored while airborne. A Springer Spaniel and a mixed-breed dog seem unsure of what's happening. An Australian shepherd shows off its best side profile.
translated_content: Amb el pelatge voleiant i les potes estirades, unes fotos captivadores mostren gossos domèstics que semblen posar a l'aire. La fotògrafa alemanya Julia Christe va capturar amb habilitat aquestes imatges a mig salt, amb diverses races, incloent-hi huskies i gossos crestats xinesos. Per crear aquestes fotos, els gossos van ser deixats caure suaument sobre un matalàs pels seus propietaris des d'una alçada baixa, i es van fer servir màquines de vent per afegir-hi un toc dramàtic. Un puli sembla volar per l'aire, capturat per Julia Christe, una fotògrafa de 41 anys de Tettnang, Alemanya. Un husky adorable mostra el seu millor costat, mentre que un spitz sembla volar. El projecte va sorgir quan Christe, buscant una nova perspectiva del seu animal preferit, va decidir embarcar-se en aquesta sèrie. Tot i que inicialment no havia planejat especialitzar-se en fotografia de mascotes (tot i tenir dos gossos d'aigua espanyols), el treball de Christe en sessions fotogràfiques comercials d'animals va encendre la seva passió pels retrats de mascotes. El seu darrer projecte, 'Freestyle', va mostrar més de 100 canins al seu estudi de Berlín, incloent-hi bòxers, griffons nivernais, collies barbuts i pastors australians, entre d'altres. 'Els gossos van ser deixats caure pels seus propietaris sobre un matalàs des d'una alçada mínima, i la il·lusió de vol es va millorar amb màquines de vent', va explicar la fotògrafa de 41 anys. Un llebrer afganès fa una posa a l'aire per a la càmera. Un collie barbut adorable i un teckel semblen volar per l'aire. La fotògrafa Julia Christe, de 41 anys, de Tettnang, Alemanya, està fotografiada amb un dels seus gossos. 'No tots els gossos estan fets per 'volar', però alguns van mostrar un talent notable i es van convertir en veritables estrelles. Algunes races, com els llebrers, tenien por de ser aixecats, mentre que d'altres, com els spaniels, ho van gaudir molt. 'Alguns gossos ho van gaudir tant que vam poder repetir els salts. Les expressions a les seves cares sovint reflecteixen la sorpresa del 'vol' inicial, i el primer salt normalment va proporcionar les millors imatges.' Tot i això, no tothom aprecia el seu treball. Christe ha rebut comunicacions d'organitzacions de drets dels animals que expressen preocupacions sobre el benestar dels gossos. 'Rebo reaccions variades a les meves fotos, que van des de la fascinació i l'astorament fins a les preocupacions expressades pels activistes dels drets dels animals', va afegir. Un collie barbut es prepara per 'volar' darrere les càmeres durant la sessió de fotos. La fotògrafa Julia pretenia capturar el seu animal preferit des d'un punt de vista únic. Un enorme gos de Terranova sembla volar, amb el seu pelatge negre sedós sacsejat pel vent. Un petit gos crestat xinès aixeca una cama per a la càmera. 'Realment estimo els animals i la seva seguretat era primordial; mai no arriscaria que es fessin mal. 'Es va fer un esforç tècnic considerable per crear les fotografies, incloent-hi l'ajust precís de la il·luminació i la captura del moviment ràpid del pelatge dels gossos. 'Crec que les fotografies mostren la gràcia i l'elegància dels gossos, presentant-los d'una manera subtilment diferent i única.' Un beagle fa una posa, mentre que un griffon nivernais sembla perplex. Un setter anglès sembla avorrit mentre és a l'aire. Un springer spaniel i un gos de raça mixta semblen no saber què està passant. Un pastor australià mostra el seu millor perfil.

article_content: Soulja Boy is facing three felony charges following an early morning traffic stop. Police reported finding 'a felony amount' of marijuana, firearms, and 'a substantial amount of cash' in the vehicle. The 21-year-old rapper, whose real name is DeAndre Cortez Way, posted a $10,000 bond on Tuesday afternoon after spending approximately twelve hours in the Carroll County, Georgia, jail, according to a police spokeswoman. Soulja Boy was a passenger in a rented black Cadillac Escalade with four other men on Interstate 20, about 50 miles west of Atlanta, when they were stopped for a routine traffic violation at 2:30 a.m., according to Temple Police spokeswoman Dana Rampy. Temple Police Officer Lat Gray arrested all five men after discovering the marijuana, cash, and firearms, Rampy stated. The men were 'very cordial' and cooperative with police, she noted. Each individual faces three felony counts, including possession of marijuana, possession of marijuana with intent to distribute, and possession of a firearm during the commission of a crime, Rampy confirmed. Representatives for Soulja Boy have not yet responded to a CNN request for comment.

article_content: Johannesburg, South Africa (CNN) -- South Africa boasts a rich musical heritage, and Johannesburg-based indie rockers BLK JKS are contributing a new sound of their own. Rolling Stone magazine described them as 'Africa's best new band,' and BLK JKS (pronounced Black Jacks) recently completed a six-month tour of the United States and Europe. Their debut album, 'After Robots,' released last year, was recorded in the United States and put out by an American label. It has garnered critical acclaim for its eclectic mix of prog rock, dub, and traditional South African rhythms. Despite their music's global appeal, the band emphasizes that their roots remain firmly planted in South Africa. BLK JKS's drummer and bassist were raised in the Johannesburg township of Soweto, while the singer and guitarist grew up 30 minutes away in the East Rand neighborhood. Drummer Tshepang Ramoba told CNN, 'It is important to know where you live, where you come from, your history, and what's happening in the world.' Although their fusion of styles is creating a buzz outside South Africa, acceptance in their home country was initially challenging, as four black musicians playing rock music is still uncommon. Guitarist Mpumi Mcata told CNN, 'In the beginning, people were like, 'oh, they are black, they play rock ...' South Africa is still segregated, so you have a situation where they put us in front of a white audience, and the white audience is confused, and you put us in front of a black audience, and the black audience is confused. So it's not an easy crossover.' However, Mcata asserts that the band's music is ultimately rooted in tradition, with their rock sound built around 'ancient rhythms.' Ramoba concurred, stating that South African traditions are central to the band's music. 'The last song on the album is called Tselane, a story we used to be told when we were young before we would go to bed,' he said. 'Those fables connect to how we're living now,' Mcata added. While the band has toured extensively in Europe and the United States, they consider their most memorable gig to be in Soweto itself, where the South African dance music genre of Kwaito dominates. 'In Soweto, if they don't like you, they don't like you. They'll throw bottles,' Ramoba said. 'So in Soweto, the fact that they liked us is a huge thing. When we started playing, everyone just stayed and danced. It was the best.'
translated_content: Johannesburg, Sud-àfrica (CNN) -- Sud-àfrica presumeix d'un ric patrimoni musical, i els rockers indie BLK JKS, amb seu a Johannesburg, hi contribueixen amb un so nou i propi. La revista Rolling Stone els va descriure com 'la millor banda nova d'Àfrica', i BLK JKS (pronunciat Black Jacks) ha completat recentment una gira de sis mesos pels Estats Units i Europa. El seu àlbum de debut, 'After Robots', publicat l'any passat, va ser enregistrat als Estats Units i editat per un segell americà. Ha obtingut elogis de la crítica per la seva barreja eclèctica de prog rock, dub i ritmes tradicionals sud-africans. Malgrat l'atractiu global de la seva música, la banda emfatitza que les seves arrels romanen fermament plantades a Sud-àfrica. El bateria i el baixista de BLK JKS van créixer al municipi de Soweto, a Johannesburg, mentre que el cantant i el guitarrista van créixer a 30 minuts de distància, al barri d'East Rand. El bateria Tshepang Ramoba va dir a CNN: 'És important saber on vius, d'on vens, la teva història i què està passant al món.' Tot i que la seva fusió d'estils crea expectació fora de Sud-àfrica, l'acceptació al seu país d'origen va ser inicialment difícil, ja que quatre músics negres que toquen rock encara és poc comú. El guitarrista Mpumi Mcata va dir a CNN: 'Al principi, la gent deia, 'oh, són negres, toquen rock...' Sud-àfrica encara està segregada, així que et trobes en una situació en què ens posen davant d'un públic blanc, i el públic blanc està confós, i ens posen davant d'un públic negre, i el públic negre està confós. Així que no és un *crossover* fàcil.' No obstant això, Mcata afirma que la música de la banda està arrelada a la tradició, amb el seu so rock construït al voltant de 'ritmes antics'. Ramoba va coincidir, afirmant que les tradicions sud-africanes són fonamentals per a la música de la banda. 'L'última cançó de l'àlbum es diu Tselane, una història que ens explicaven quan érem petits abans d'anar a dormir', va dir. 'Aquestes faules connecten amb com vivim ara', va afegir Mcata. Tot i que la banda ha fet gires extenses per Europa i els Estats Units, consideren que el seu concert més memorable va ser a la mateixa Soweto, on domina el gènere de música *kwaito* sud-africana. 'A Soweto, si no els caus bé, no els caus bé; et llancen ampolles', va dir Ramoba. 'Així que a Soweto, el fet que els agradéssim és una gran cosa. Quan vam començar a tocar, tothom es va quedar i va ballar. Va ser el millor.'

article_content: Following the catastrophic tsunami of 2004, which claimed approximately 245,000 lives across 14 nations bordering the Indian Ocean, significant strides have been made in establishing early warning systems. Yudi Rinaldi, an Indonesian survivor from Aceh, poignantly recreated his harrowing escape with his son, Ryan, during a recent tsunami drill. This exercise was part of a larger effort involving 20 countries to evaluate the effectiveness of newly implemented tsunami detection and alert technologies, including deep-water buoys, sirens, tide gauges, and comprehensive communication networks. While these advancements allow Indonesia to potentially issue tsunami warnings within five minutes of detecting an undersea earthquake, experts like Costas Synolakis from the University of South California emphasize that technology alone is insufficient. The primary challenge lies in adequately educating communities to recognize and respond appropriately to tsunami warning signs, irrespective of whether an official alert has been issued. Krishna Vatsa, a disaster-reduction advisor for the UNDP in South Asia, recognizes that despite India's advanced early warning system implemented in 2007, broader network coverage is still needed to ensure that even the most remote coastal villages receive timely information. Sanny Jegillos of the UNDP noted that some nations, like Myanmar, Bangladesh, and certain East African countries, still need to invest more in public education initiatives. Stanley Goosby from the Pacific Disaster Center stresses the necessity of an 'end-to-end system' that integrates community education into school curriculums, highlighting that a comprehensive approach is required for genuine preparedness, thus ensuring better outcomes when disasters strike.
translated_content: Després del tsunami catastròfic del 2004, que va causar aproximadament 245.000 morts a 14 nacions que limiten amb l'Oceà Índic, s'han fet avenços significatius en l'establiment de sistemes d'alerta primerenca. Yudi Rinaldi, un supervivent indonesi d'Aceh, va recrear de manera commovedora la seva escapada esgarrifosa amb el seu fill, Ryan, durant un simulacre de tsunami recent. Aquest exercici formava part d'un esforç més gran que involucrava 20 països per avaluar l'eficàcia de les tecnologies de detecció i alerta de tsunamis recentment implementades, incloent boies d'aigües profundes, sirenes, mareògrafs i xarxes de comunicació integrals. Tot i que aquests avenços permeten a Indonèsia emetre potencialment avisos de tsunami en cinc minuts després de detectar un terratrèmol submarí, experts com Costas Synolakis de la Universitat del Sud de Califòrnia emfatitzen que la tecnologia per si sola és insuficient. El principal desafiament rau a educar adequadament les comunitats per reconèixer i respondre adequadament als senyals d'advertència de tsunamis, independentment de si s'ha emès una alerta oficial. Krishna Vatsa, assessora de reducció de desastres per al PNUD a l'Àsia meridional, reconeix que, malgrat el sistema d'alerta primerenca avançat de l'Índia implementat el 2007, encara es necessita una cobertura de xarxa més àmplia per garantir que fins i tot els pobles costaners més remots rebin informació oportuna. Sanny Jegillos del PNUD va assenyalar que algunes nacions, com Myanmar, Bangladesh i certs països de l'Àfrica Oriental, encara han d'invertir més en iniciatives d'educació pública. Stanley Goosby del Centre de Desastres del Pacífic subratlla la necessitat d'un 'sistema integral' que integri l'educació comunitària als currículums escolars, destacant que cal un enfocament integral per a una preparació genuïna, garantint així millors resultats quan es produeixin desastres.

article_content: By Louise Boyle PUBLISHED: 16:56 EST, August 14, 2012 UPDATED: 14:00 EST, August 15, 2012 An 18-year-old man accused of beating his five-year-old niece to death with a sickle has appeared in court wearing a full-body 'suicide smock'. Matthew Kaleb Pierson has been charged with murder after confessing to killing Jada Beth Williams with the farming tool and stuffing her bloodied body in a plastic container in the family garage. A preliminary autopsy revealed that the girl died from blunt force injuries to the head, face, and neck at the home in Jackson Township, Ohio. Charged with murder: Matthew Kaleb Pierson, 18, appears at Hillsboro Municipal Court, Ohio, wearing a suicide smock. Unexplained: The teenager allegedly beat his five-year-old niece to death at their home on Saturday with a sickle. Pierson entered court on Tuesday with his hands bound and wearing a 'suicide smock'. Authorities stated that it was standard procedure for individuals accused of such crimes to be placed in the gown. Anti-suicide smocks are made from quilted nylon Cordura - a material ten times tougher than denim jeans. It cannot be torn, folded, or rolled to prevent prisoners from hanging themselves. Authorities found the sickle at the home, east of Cincinnati, where the child's body was also discovered, Highland County Sheriff Ron Ward said. It was unclear which part of the tool was used in the beating. The child's body was found on Sunday, placed in a plastic container at the home where she lived with the accused and her grandmother. The grandmother called 911 on Sunday afternoon, reporting that the girl was dead and covered in blood. Pierson told authorities he killed his niece on Saturday at the house and described the weapon he used, Detective Randy Sanders said in an affidavit filed in Hillsboro Municipal Court. Pierson also mentioned 'placing the body in the position in which Jada's body was found'. Motive unclear: Matthew Kaleb Pierson, 18, has been charged with the murder of his five-year-old niece, Jada Beth Williams, in Ohio. A motive for the murder remains unclear. A judge set bail at $500,000 during Pierson's arraignment on Tuesday. Highland County Prosecutor Anneka Collins declined to comment but indicated that more charges were possible. A preliminary hearing has been scheduled for August 23. Other individuals may be charged in connection with the girl's murder, Highland County Sheriff Ron Ward said at a press conference on Monday. A 38-year-old man who owns the house was held as a person of interest but was later released. According to the Fayette Advocate, a search warrant revealed several people were at the home on Saturday night and were aware that something might have happened to the little girl. One woman present stated she thought she saw 'blood on the carpet in the front room' and that there 'might be a body out there'. Another woman present at the house reportedly told her it was a 'doll'. Sheriff Ward said: 'Part of the investigation concerns who had care/custody of this child. Someone failed this child.' Chilling: Pierson told police that he had killed his niece Jada (right) on Saturday afternoon at the home they shared with their grandmother. Disposal: The 18-year-old left his niece's body in a plastic container where the grandmother found her.
